title: Account was already locked or revoked

support.label: no lockout event inside the window
one host carries at least 80% of failures
retries arrive at a regular interval

next_steps: Run the investigation again with a longer window so it includes the failures that caused the lockout.
Do not request an unlock yet. Whatever locked {account} is probably still running on {top_host} and will lock it again.
If the account is not locked and these errors continue, open a ticket with the identity team and quote this reference, because the Kerberos code seen can also mean disabled or expired.
